title: Repossession and Collateral Recovery Personal Property Holding Terms by Class
content:
When personal property is found in a vehicle that comes into Harborline's possession under Repossession and Collateral Recovery, the holding terms are the same in every collateral class.

| Collateral class | Days the property is held after the property notice is mailed | Fee for holding the property (USD) | Days after recovery within which the property notice is mailed |
|---|---|---|---|
| Recovery Class 1 Passenger Car | 30 | 0.00 | 5 |
| Recovery Class 2 Minivan and Crossover | 30 | 0.00 | 5 |
| Recovery Class 3 Sport Utility Vehicle | 30 | 0.00 | 5 |
| Recovery Class 4 Light-Duty Pickup | 30 | 0.00 | 5 |
| Recovery Class 5 Heavy-Duty Pickup | 30 | 0.00 | 5 |
| Recovery Class 6 Full-Size Van | 30 | 0.00 | 5 |

Column meanings as defined for the program: calendar days personal property found in the vehicle is held for retrieval after the property notice is mailed; fee charged for holding personal property; calendar days after recovery within which the personal property notice is mailed.

**Basis Q&A**

- *Is there a charge for keeping belongings?* No class charges for it: the holding fee is 0.00 in all six classes.
- *How long are belongings held?* 30 calendar days after the property notice is mailed, in every class.
